messages:
Maria G.: opened PR for a tiny migration follow-up — updates to the trace->dashboard guide and the kv-cache example. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824 :wave:
Alex P.: looking now. quick note — one of the Node snippets still uses old param name `trace_key` instead of `traceKey`, that's why the SDK sample fails in the playground.
Jun L.: I can take the Node snippet. Should we also add a short note about sequence length impact on cost breakdown? folks keep missing that.
Maria G.: yes please. add a 1-sentence note under the cost/latency matrix: "shorter avg sequence => lower per-token cost due to better batching" or similar. keep it non-technical.
Samir R.: on it. For the kv-cache example, the sample currently shows manual prefixing; recommend switching to auto-prefix API usage. small patch will be:
```js
// old
const key = `sess:${sessionId}:kv`
await kv.set(key, kvPayload)
// new
await kv.setForSession(sessionId, kvPayload) // uses managed prefixing
```
Samir R.: will push as separate commit in the same PR so we can review independently.
Alex P.: thanks. when you push, tag me — I want to verify the code block formatting (backticks and language) so the rendered docs don't lose highlight.
Elaine C.: quick UX ask — can we also add an inline anchor next to the cost table for "trace-level attribution" so internal customers can link directly? tiny HTML anchor is fine.
Maria G.: good idea. Elaine, can you add that anchor and a note about how to consume the trace id in dashboards? 1-2 lines.
Elaine C.: will do. also ran the linkcheck locally — found one broken internal link to /sdk/node/legacy that the PR currently points to. I propose replacing with /sdk/node/current (3 occurrences).
docs-bot: CI docs build succeeded for PR #4824 (docs-4824-kvcache-snippet) — build 4593. :white_check_mark:
Jun L.: pushed Node snippet fix and added the sequence-length note. left a comment in the PR about a tiny wording nit in the cost paragraph.
Samir R.: pushed kv helper change, separated commit, and fixed the triple-backtick fence spacing so the snippet renders in small viewports.
Alex P.: reviewed both commits and left an approval on the kv change. small nit on variable naming (sessId -> sessionId) in one place.
Elaine C.: replaced the three /legacy links with /current and added the anchor. also added a short example: "use trace_id in dashboard filters" with example filter expression.
Maria G.: awesome — final checklist: 1) fix naming nit (Alex) 2) squash docs-bot unrelated auto-lint commit? (if harmless we can keep) 3) merge after approvals. anyone object to me merging later today?
Alex P.: no objections from me, will fix that var name and re-approve.
Samir R.: no objections.
Jun L.: none.
Maria G.: thanks folks — I'll wait for Alex then merge. tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: thread about docs PR coordination: migration guide edits, snippet fixes, link replacements, small UX anchor addition, and CI pass. kept messages short and Slack-like.
